board.label: Accessible name (aria-label) of the Kanban board region holding every FEATURE card. Not shown on screen.
board.empty.title: Heading of the empty state when the plan has no FEATURE cards. FEATURE is a card type prefix — keep it as written.
board.empty.description: Empty-state body below board.empty.title. FEATURE is a card type prefix — keep it. {path} is a file path pattern (feature/FEATURE-*.md).
board.column.planned.title: Kanban column heading for cards whose status is 'planned'. Column is 18rem wide, next to a count badge — keep short. Capitalised heading form of status.planned.
board.column.building.title: Kanban column heading for cards whose status is 'building' (work in progress). Keep short.
board.column.built.title: Kanban column heading for cards whose status is 'built' (done, not yet verified). Keep short.
board.column.verified.title: Kanban column heading for cards whose status is 'verified' (built and checked). Keep short.
board.column.planned.empty: Italic hint in the empty Planned column.
board.column.building.empty: Italic hint in the empty Building column ('in flight' = currently being worked on).
board.column.built.empty: Italic hint in the empty Built column.
board.column.verified.empty: Italic hint in the empty Verified column.
board.column.emptyFallback: Italic hint in an empty Kanban column that declares no hint of its own.
board.overflow: Link at the foot of the Verified column, which shows at most 20 cards. {count} is how many more verified cards are hidden; the link opens the full list.
board.kanban.defaultLabel: Fallback accessible name of a Kanban board region when the caller gives none. Not shown on screen.
board.tasks.title: Page heading of the Tasks area (the board and list views of FEATURE cards).
board.tasks.tab.board: Tab label: the Kanban board view. Tabs are narrow — one short word.
board.tasks.tab.list: Tab label: the list view. Tabs are narrow — one short word.
board.tasks.blurb.board: One-line description under the Tasks heading on the board tab. FEATURE is a card type prefix — keep it. {field} is the frontmatter key 'status:' and stays as written.
board.tasks.blurb.list: One-line description under the Tasks heading on the list tab. 'Release provenance' = which release shipped each feature. FEATURE is a card type prefix — keep it.
board.dialog.close: Accessible name of the ✕ button and the backdrop that close the card preview dialog.
board.dialog.noBody: Italic placeholder in the card preview when the card has no markdown body.
board.dialog.connections: Small uppercase heading above the list of connected cards in the preview dialog.
board.dialog.connectionCount: Footer of the preview dialog, small monospace text. {count} is the number of cards connected to this one.
board.dialog.openCard: Footer link from the preview dialog to the card's full page. The arrow is decorative.
board.dialog.notFound: Shown in the preview dialog when the URL names a card that does not exist. {handle} is a card identifier such as API-TICKETS.
features.empty: Empty state of the feature list. FEATURE is a card type prefix — keep it. {path} is a file path pattern shown as code.
features.sectionEmpty: Italic hint under a feature-list section heading that has no cards.
features.section.upNext: Small uppercase section heading: features not yet built (planned, building, or no status). A count follows it.
features.section.shipped: Small uppercase section heading: features that are built or verified. A count follows it.
features.pr.link: Compact chip linking to a pull request on GitHub. 'PR' = pull request; ↗ marks an external link. Keep as short as possible.
features.pr.number: Compact chip naming a pull request. {pr} is the PR number or id from the card. Keep short.
docs.eyebrow: Small label above the compiled document's title, on its cover.
docs.defaultTitle: Title of the compiled document when the plan does not set one.
docs.imprint: Cover line under the document title. {version} is the package version number (the 'v' prefix stands for 'version'); {date} is today's date, already formatted.
docs.card.openSource: Tooltip on a card's handle link inside the document. {handle} is the card identifier, e.g. DOC-FILE-FORMAT.
docs.toc.heading: Heading of the table of contents (in the side rail and on the printed contents page); also its accessible name on the printed page.
docs.toc.navLabel: Accessible name of the table-of-contents navigation in the side rail.
docs.toc.jumpLabel: Accessible label of the drop-down that jumps to a section on narrow screens.
docs.toc.jumpPlaceholder: Placeholder of that drop-down before a section is picked.
docs.toc.wholeDocument: Link in the contents rail back from one section to the whole document. Rail is 13rem wide.
docs.toc.empty: Shown in the contents rail when no card belongs to a section. {field} is the frontmatter key 'section:' and stays as written.
docs.empty.title: Heading of the empty state when the plan has no documentation sections.
docs.empty.description: Body of that empty state. {field} is the frontmatter key 'section:', {listField} the key 'doc_sections:', {handle} the card identifier PLAN-PROJECT — all stay as written. A 'slug' is a short identifier.
docs.empty.unknownTitle: Heading when the URL names a documentation section that does not exist.
docs.empty.unknownSection: Body when the URL names a section no card declares. {field} is the frontmatter key 'section:' (stays as written); {section} is the section id from the URL.
docs.export.button: Small button on the document cover that opens a print window for saving as PDF.
docs.export.blockedTitle: Toast title when the browser blocked the print window from opening.
docs.export.blockedMessage: Toast body under docs.export.blockedTitle. {shortcut} is the keyboard shortcut ⌘P. “Save as PDF” is the browser's own print-dialog option — use the wording browsers show in your language.
docs.print.action: Large button in the print window that opens the browser's print dialog (verb).
docs.print.preparing: Same button while diagrams are still rendering; it is disabled.
docs.print.windowTitle: Second part of the print window's tab title, after the document title ('My project · Print'). It also becomes the default PDF file name.
docs.print.empty: Shown in the print window when there is nothing to print. {field} is the frontmatter key 'section:' and stays as written.
docs.print.hint.waiting: Hint beside the Print button while the diagrams render.
docs.print.hint.ready: Hint beside the Print button once ready. “Save as PDF” is the browser's own print-dialog option — use the wording browsers show in your language.
docs.print.hint.partial: Hint beside the Print button when some diagrams failed to render before the time limit.
